fichas.title: Climbing Halls
fichas.summary: Indoor climbing halls accommodate bouldering and roped climbing, with flexible wall forms and heights. The layout should concentrate subsidiary functions and distinguish areas for beginners, experts and children. Daylighting is desirable, artificial lighting should avoid glare, and climbing walls require regular expert maintenance. Wall construction and grip selection vary by user group and climbing-wall type.
furniture_equipment: Gravel, bark mulch or mats for bouldering landing areas
